answer: At dawn each epoch, the protocol samples a random jetty node to co-sign the registry, so forging identities requires renting real hardware and outbidding honest stake. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit locked to a unique hardware attestation, and new identities join a queue weighted by prior epoch uptime. A sybil swarm must also survive a comet-style challenge: reveal a fresh proof-of-location within minutes or forfeit the bond, making mass fakery costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
